name: enrich-work-item
description: Apply type-specific enricher prompts to produce team-format Epic, Feature, User Story, or Task documentation; persist on approval through the tracker gateway. When source is a tracker item, ingests its fields, artifacts, and description-referenced documents before enrichment.

work_item_type.description: Vendor-neutral work item type to enrich

source.description: Tracker work-item link or id, external doc URL, local path, or inline text to enrich. Tracker sources trigger artifact and description-reference resolution through tracker_get_work_item.

parent.description: Parent work item id or link for hierarchy context. Optional when source is a tracker item — defaults to its parent.

attachment.description: Additional documentation URL or path, merged with any artifacts discovered on a tracker source work item
